label: coach_event_tutorial_headbb_01
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]There you are, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]! Just
the
person
I
was
looking
for![VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: coach_event_tutorial_headbb_02
text: I heard the news—you’re the new BB League\nChampion, am I right?![VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: coach_event_tutorial_headbb_03
text: I’ll admit it—I’m blown away!\c\nInviting you to this academy was the best\ndecision I’ve made recently![VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: coach_event_tutorial_headbb_04
text:
So, now that you’ve had some time to get
comfortable here...\c
How do you find Blueberry Academy? Are you
having fun?[VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: coach_event_tutorial_select_01
text: I love it here!

label: coach_event_tutorial_select_02
text: So-so, I guess

label: coach_event_tutorial_headbb_05
text: Good, good. Just what I like to hear.[VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: coach_event_tutorial_headbb_06
text: So-so, eh? I’m sure you mean it’s so, soooooo\ngreat, right?[VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: coach_event_tutorial_headbb_07
text: Anyway, there’s a small favor I’d like to ask of\nyou, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]...[VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: coach_event_tutorial_headbb_08
text: Y’see, the whole academy’s become so much\nmore lively and energetic since you came here.[VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: coach_event_tutorial_headbb_09
text: And that got me thinking—maybe we should have\neven MORE people come visit from Paldea! Have\r\nthem come as [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]special coaches[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] or something![VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: coach_event_tutorial_headbb_10
text: You know a lot of people, right? You’ve got lots\nof friends and everything?[VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: coach_event_tutorial_headbb_11
text: I mean, like, teachers from your school, Gym\nLeaders—that sort of thing! Oh, and any strong\r\nfriends of yours are also welcome here![VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: coach_event_tutorial_select_03
text: Leave it to me!

label: coach_event_tutorial_select_04
text: Uhhh...

label: coach_event_tutorial_headbb_12
text: Spoken like a true Champion! I knew you were\nthe right person to ask![VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: coach_event_tutorial_headbb_13
text: Wow! Already thinking about who you can call,\nhuh? I knew you were the right one to ask![VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: coach_event_tutorial_headbb_14
text: You can use the clubroom computer to contact\nanyone you want to invite![VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: coach_event_tutorial_system_01
text: Oh, but it’ll cost BP—we’ll need to pay for their\ntrip and such. Here’s some to get you started.[VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: coach_event_tutorial_headbb_15
text: You received 200 BP from Director Cyrano!

label: coach_event_tutorial_headbb_16
text: I think I’ll arrange for the special coaches to stay\nin this clubroom when they’re not teaching. You\r\nshould have a chat with them while they’re here![VAR 0x0114(004B)]

label: coach_event_tutorial_headbb_17
text: Now then, I’ll leave it to you! Enjoy![VAR 0x0114(004B)]
